item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `UserFirstAdapter(dspy.ChatAdapter)` overriding `format(signature, demos, inputs)`, calls `super().format(...)`, and returns `[messages[1], messages[0], *messages[2:]]`, producing `user` then `system` in the demonstrated call."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"By reusing `super().format(...)` and only swapping the leading messages, the answer shows the stock adapter layout is being minimally adjusted at the adapter layer rather than by forking prompt construction."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"It routes `Predict` through the custom adapter via `dspy.configure(lm=lm, adapter=adapter)` and verifies the actual LM call through `lm.history[-1][\"messages\"]`, showing `Predict` used that adapter path."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Provides a complete offline `DummyLM` program, runs `Predict`, prints the sent roles/messages, and asserts the executed request begins with `user` then `system`."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
